name: South East Charters
description: South East Charters is run by skipper Michael Kent, who has operated his own charter boat off south-east Tasmania for almost 20 years. His boat, Phantom, is a 26-foot (about 7.5-metre) aluminium boat built locally by Mariner Aluminium, powered by twin 115 hp Yamaha four-strokes and in AMSA survey for five passengers, with a toilet and padded seating in the cabin and on deck. Bottom and reef fishing runs all year from Orford or Dunalley around Maria Island for flathead, perch, gurnard, squid, striped trumpeter, salmon, gummy shark, kingfish and couta. From March to August, full-day game trips leave Eaglehawk Neck or Port Arthur for albacore, striped, yellowfin and bluefin tuna, switching to bottom fishing if the tuna are absent. Prices are a flat rate for the boat, and the skipper can try to make up a group for solo anglers. Penn, Fin-Nor and Alvey gear is supplied and the catch is cleaned and packed. Families and children are catered for; bring your own food and drink.
departure_address: Eaglehawk Neck or Port Arthur (game fishing); Orford or Dunalley (bottom fishing); other locations by request

faqs.q: Are South East Charters prices per person or per boat?
faqs.a: All prices are a flat rate for the boat. A $900 full day shared by four people works out at $225 each, and the skipper can try to build a group if you are on your own.

faqs.q: Can I do a half-day tuna trip?
faqs.a: No. Game fishing from Eaglehawk Neck or Port Arthur is full day only; half days are for bottom and reef fishing.
